sentences.zh: 占曰：「國敗君亡，大兵起，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The state is defeated, its ruler perishes; great armies rise; armies are broken and generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "State defeated, ruler dead, great war, shattered armies, slain generals."

sentences.zh: 」來年三月，吳明徹敗于呂梁，十三年帝崩，敗國亡君之應也。

translations.literal: Third month of the next year, Wu Mingche was defeated at Lüliang; thirteenth year the Emperor died—the response to defeat, loss of state, and death of ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, third month, Wu Mingche fell at Lüliang; thirteenth year the emperor died—fulfilling defeat and dynastic collapse.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月己丑，歲星太白辰星合于東井。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, fourth month, jichou day—Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury conjoined in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, fourth month, jichou: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury conjoined in the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月壬寅，白虹見西方。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, second month, renyin day—a white rainbow appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year, second month, renyin: a white rainbow appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有喪。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Mourning follows."

sentences.zh: 」其後十三年帝崩。

translations.literal: Afterward, thirteenth year, the Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, thirteenth year, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，月犯牽牛吳越之野。

translations.literal: Tenth month, wuwu day—the moon violated the Lead Ox in the Wu-Yue region.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuwu: the moon crossed the Lead Ox in the Wu-Yue region.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其國亡，君有憂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "That state perishes; the ruler has sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "That state falls; the ruler grieves."

sentences.zh: 」後年帝崩。

translations.literal: The next year the Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，歲星犯執法。

translations.literal: Xinyou day—Jupiter violated the Law-enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Xinyou: Jupiter crossed the Law-enforcer.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，辰星在太白上。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guiyou day—Mercury was above Venus.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiyou: Mercury stood above Venus.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，辰星太白交相掩。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day—Mercury and Venus mutually masked each other.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxu: Mercury and Venus occulted each other.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大兵在野，大戰。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great armies in the field; great battle."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great armies in the field; great battle."

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，彗星見西南。

translations.literal: Xinsi day—a comet appeared in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Xinsi: a comet appeared in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有兵喪。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is warfare and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "War and mourning follow."

sentences.zh: 」明年帝崩，始興王叔陵作亂。

translations.literal: The next year the Emperor died and Prince Shiling of Shixing raised rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the emperor died and Prince Shiling of Shixing rebelled.

sentences.zh: 後主至德元年正月壬戌，蓬星見。

translations.literal: Last Ruler, Zhide first year, first month, renxu day—the Wandering star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Last Ruler, Zhide first year, first month, renxu: the Wandering star appeared.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「必有亡國亂臣。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There are certain to be a fallen state and rebellious ministers."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "A fallen state and rebellious ministers are certain."

sentences.zh: 」後帝於太皇寺捨身作奴，以祈冥助，不恤國政，為施文慶等所惑，以至國亡。

translations.literal: Afterward the Emperor at Taichang Temple renounced the throne to become a slave, praying for otherworldly aid, neglecting state affairs, deluded by Shi Wenqing and others, until the state perished.
translations.idiomatic: Later the emperor "sold himself" as a temple slave at Taichang, neglected government, was led astray by Shi Wenqing and others, and lost the realm.

sentences.zh: 魏普泰元年十月，歲星熒惑填星太白聚於觜參，色甚明大。

translations.literal: Wei, Putai first year, tenth month—Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, and Venus gathered at Beak and Three Stars, their colors very bright and large.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, Putai first year, tenth month: Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, and Venus gathered at Beak and Three Stars, bright and large.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「當有王者興。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "A true king is about to rise."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "A true king is about to rise."

sentences.zh: 」其月，齊高祖起于信都，至中興二年春而破爾硃兆，遂開霸業。

translations.literal: That month, Qi Grand Ancestor rose at Xindu; by Zhongxing second year spring he broke Erzhu Zhao and opened the path to hegemony.
translations.idiomatic: That month Northern Qi's founder rose at Xindu; by Zhongxing second year he broke Erzhu Zhao and began his rise.

sentences.zh: 魏武定四年九月丁未，高祖圍玉壁城，有星墜于營，眾驢皆鳴。

translations.literal: Wei, Wuding fourth year, ninth month, dingwei day—Grand Ancestor besieged Yubi city; a star fell in the camp and all the donkeys brayed.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Wuding fourth year, ninth month, dingwei: besieging Yubi, a star fell in camp and every donkey brayed.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Armies broken, generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Armies shattered, generals slain."

sentences.zh: 」高祖不豫，五年正月丙午崩。

translations.literal: Grand Ancestor fell ill; fifth year, first month, bingwu day, he died.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor fell ill and died fifth year, first month, bingwu.

sentences.zh: 齊文宣帝天保元年十二月甲申，熒惑犯房北頭第一星及鉤鈐。

translations.literal: Northern Qi Emperor Wenxuan, Tianbao first year, twelfth month, jiashen day—Mars violated the first star at the north head of Room and the Hooked Clasp.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi Wenxuan, Tianbao first year, twelfth month, jiashen: Mars crossed Room's north head star and the Hooked Clasp.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣有反者。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great ministers rebel."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great ministers rebel."

sentences.zh: 」其二年二月壬辰，太尉彭樂謀反，誅。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, renchen day—Grand Marshal Peng Le plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, second month, renchen: Grand Marshal Peng Le plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 八年二月己亥，歲星守少微，經六十三日。

translations.literal: Eighth year, second month, jihai day—Jupiter guarded Lesser Supreme, passing sixty-three days.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, second month, jihai: Jupiter guarded Lesser Supreme for sixty-three days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「五官亂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The Five Offices are in disorder."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The Five Offices fall into disorder."

sentences.zh: 」五月癸卯，歲星犯太微上將。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guimao day—Jupiter violated the Upper General of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guimao: Jupiter crossed the Supreme Palace's Upper General.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大將憂，大臣死。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great generals grieve; great ministers die."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great generals grieve; great ministers die."

sentences.zh: 」其十年五月，誅諸元宗室四十餘家，乾明元年，誅楊遵彥等，皆五官亂，大將憂，大臣死之應也。

translations.literal: Tenth year, fifth month, over forty households of the Yuan clan were executed; Ganming first year, Yang Zunyan and others were killed—all responses to disorder of the Five Offices, grief of great generals, and death of great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, fifth month, forty Yuan clans were executed; Ganming first year Yang Zunyan and others were killed—fulfilling the omen of court chaos and ministerial death.

sentences.zh: 八年七月甲辰，月掩心星。

translations.literal: Eighth year, seventh month, jiachen day—the moon masked the Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, seventh month, jiachen: the moon occulted the Heart star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「人主惡之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The ruler detests it."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The ruler dreads this omen."

sentences.zh: 」十年十月，帝崩。

translations.literal: Tenth year, tenth month, the Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, tenth month, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，熒惑犯鬼質。

translations.literal: Ninth year, second month—Mars violated the Ghost Sentence.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, second month: Mars crossed the Ghost Sentence.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「斧質用，有大喪。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The axe is used; there is great mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The executioner's axe is used; great mourning follows."

sentences.zh: 」三月甲午，熒惑犯軒轅。

translations.literal: Third month, jiawu day—Mars violated the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiawu: Mars crossed the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主惡之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The chief consort detests it."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The chief consort dreads this omen."

sentences.zh: 」其十年五月，誅魏氏宗室，十月帝崩，斧質用，有大喪之應也。

translations.literal: Tenth year, fifth month, the Wei clan was executed; tenth month the Emperor died—the response to use of the axe and great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, fifth month, the Wei clan was executed; tenth month the emperor died—fulfilling the axe and mourning omens.

sentences.zh: 十年六月庚子，填星犯井鉞，與太白並。

translations.literal: Tenth year, sixth month, gengzi day—Saturn violated the Well Halberd and conjoined with Venus.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, sixth month, gengzi: Saturn crossed the Well Halberd and conjoined Venus.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「子為玄枵，齊之分野，君有戮死者，大臣誅，斧鉞用。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Zi is Dark Eminence; Qi's territorial division—the ruler has one who dies by execution, great ministers are executed, the axe is used."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Zi marks Qi's division—the ruler loses men to the axe; great ministers are executed."

sentences.zh: 」其明年二月乙巳，太師常山王誅尚書令楊遵彥、右僕射燕子獻、領軍可硃渾天和、侍中宋欽道等。

translations.literal: The next year, second month, yisi day—Grand Preceptor Constant Mountain Wang executed Minister of the Secretariat Yang Zunyan, Vice Director Yan Zixian, Army Commander Kezhuhun Tianhe, Palace Attendant Song Qindao, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, second month, yisi: Grand Preceptor Constant Mountain Wang executed Yang Zunyan, Yan Zixian, Kezhuhun Tianhe, Song Qindao, and others.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，廢少帝為濟南王。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renwu day—the young emperor was deposed as Prince of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renwu: the young emperor was deposed as Prince of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 廢帝乾明元年三月甲午，熒惑入軒轅。

translations.literal: Deposed Emperor, Ganming first year, third month, jiawu day—Mars entered the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Deposed Emperor, Ganming first year, third month, jiawu: Mars entered the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主凶。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The chief consort is ill-fated."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The chief consort faces ill fortune."

sentences.zh: 」後太寧二年四月，太后崩。

translations.literal: Afterward, fourth month, Taining second year, the Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Taining second year, fourth month, the empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 肅宗皇建二年四月丙子，日有食之。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong, Huangjian second year, fourth month, bingzi day—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong, Huangjian second year, fourth month, bingzi: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 子為玄枵，齊之分野。

translations.literal: Zi is Dark Eminence—Qi's territorial division.
translations.idiomatic: Zi marks Dark Eminence—Qi's territorial division.

sentences.zh: 七月乙丑，熒惑入鬼中，戊辰，犯鬼質。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yichou day—Mars entered the Ghost; wuchen day, it violated the Ghost Sentence.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yichou: Mars entered the Ghost; wuchen, it crossed the Ghost Sentence.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有大喪。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is great mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great mourning follows."

sentences.zh: 」十一月，帝以暴疾崩。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, the Emperor died of sudden illness.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, the emperor died suddenly.

sentences.zh: 武成帝河清元年七月乙亥，太白犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Emperor Wucheng, Heqing first year, seventh month, yihai day—Venus violated the Chariot Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wucheng, Heqing first year, seventh month, yihai: Venus crossed the Chariot Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有兵謀，誅大臣，斧質用。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is military plotting; great ministers are executed; the axe is used."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Military plots; great ministers executed; the axe is used."

sentences.zh: 」其年十月壬申，冀州刺史平秦王高歸彥反，段孝先討擒，斬之於都市，又其二年，殺太原王紹德，皆斧質用之應也。

translations.literal: That year, tenth month, renshen day, Inspector of Jizhou Prince Ping of Qin, Gao Guiyan, rebelled; Duan Xiaoxian captured and executed him in the market—all responses to use of the axe.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tenth month, renshen, Gao Guiyan rebelled; Duan Xiaoxian captured and beheaded him in market—fulfilling the axe omen.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，月掩畢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiayin day—the moon masked Net.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiayin: the moon occulted Net.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其國君死，大臣有誅者，有邊兵大戰，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "That state's ruler dies; great ministers are executed; there is great border warfare; armies are broken and generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The ruler dies; ministers executed; border war; shattered armies and slain generals."

sentences.zh: 」其十月，平秦王歸彥以反誅，其三年，周師與突厥入并州，大戰城西，伏屍流血百餘里，皆其應也。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Prince Ping of Qin was executed for rebellion; third year Zhou and Turks entered Bingzhou and fought a great battle west of the city—corpses and blood for over a hundred li—all responses.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month Gao Guiyan was executed; third year Zhou and Turks fought at Bingzhou with corpses for a hundred li—all as foretold.

sentences.zh: 四年正月己亥，太白犯熒惑，相去二寸，在奎。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, jihai day—Venus violated Mars, about two cun apart, in Kui.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month, jihai: Venus crossed Mars in Kui, two cun apart.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太白、熒惑、歲星合在婁。

translations.literal: Jiachen day—Venus, Mars, and Jupiter conjoined in Bond.
translations.idiomatic: Jiachen: Venus, Mars, and Jupiter conjoined in Bond.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「甲為齊。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Jia is Qi."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Jia marks Qi."

sentences.zh: 三星若合，是謂驚立絕行，其分有兵喪，改立侯王，國易政。

translations.literal: When the three stars conjoin, this is called alarmed establishment and severed movement—in that division there is military mourning; marquis-kings are changed; the state changes government.
translations.idiomatic: Three-star conjunction means alarm and severed movement—war, mourning, replaced marquis-kings, and regime change in that quarter.

sentences.zh: 」三月戊子，慧星見。

translations.literal: Third month, wuzi day—a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuzi: a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「除舊佈新，有易王。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Removing the old and spreading the new; there is change of kings."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Old order removed, new order spread; kings change."

sentences.zh: 」至四月，傳位於太子，改元。

translations.literal: By fourth month, he transferred the throne to the crown prince and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: By fourth month he abdicated to the crown prince and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 後主天統元年六月壬戌，彗星見於文昌，長數寸，入文昌，犯上將，然後經紫微宮西垣入危，漸長一丈餘，指室壁。

translations.literal: Last Ruler, Tiantong first year, sixth month, renxu day—a comet appeared at Literary Refinement, several cun long, entered Literary Refinement, violated the Upper General, then passed the western wall of the Purple Palace, entered Rooftop, gradually lengthening to over one zhang, pointing toward Room and Wall.
translations.idiomatic: Last Ruler, Tiantong first year, sixth month, renxu: a comet at Literary Refinement, entered it, crossed the Upper General, passed the Purple Palace's western wall, entered Rooftop, grew to over a zhang pointing toward Room and Wall.

sentences.zh: 後百餘日，在虛危滅。

translations.literal: Over a hundred days later it vanished in Void and Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: After a hundred-odd days it vanished in Void and Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有大喪，有亡國易政。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is great mourning; there is loss of state and change of government."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great mourning, fallen state, and regime change follow."

sentences.zh: 」其四年十二月，太上皇崩。

translations.literal: Fourth year, twelfth month, the Retired Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, twelfth month, the retired emperor died.

sentences.zh: 三年五月戊寅，甲夜，西北有赤氣竟天，夜中始滅。

translations.literal: Third year, fifth month, wuyin day—first watch of the jia night, northwest had red qi filling heaven, not vanishing until midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, fifth month, wuyin, first watch: red vapor filled the northwest sky until midnight.

sentences.zh: 十月丙午，天西北頻有赤氣。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingwu day—northwest of heaven frequently had red qi.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingwu: red vapor repeatedly filled the northwest sky.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有大兵大戰。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is great warfare on a great scale."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "War on a vast scale follows."

sentences.zh: 」後周武帝總眾來伐，大戰，有大兵之應也。

translations.literal: Afterward Emperor Wu of Zhou led the host to attack—fulfillment of great armies and great war.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou Wudi invaded at the head of a great host—fulfilling the omen of vast war.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，彗星見東井。

translations.literal: Fourth year, sixth month—a comet appeared at the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, sixth month: a comet appeared at the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大亂，國易政。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great disorder; the state changes government."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great disorder and regime change follow."

sentences.zh: 」七月，孛星見房心，白如粉絮，大如斗，東行。

translations.literal: Seventh month, a broom star appeared at Heart, white like cotton fluff, as large as a dou, moving east.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: a broom star at Heart, white as cotton, dou-sized, moving east.

sentences.zh: 八月，入天市，漸長四丈，犯瓠瓜，曆虛危，入室，犯離宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, it entered the Celestial Market, gradually lengthening to four zhang, violating Gourd, passing Void and Rooftop, entering Room, violating the Detached Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: it entered the Celestial Market, grew to four zhang, crossed Gourd, Void, Rooftop, and Room, violating the Detached Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月入奎，至婁而滅。

translations.literal: Ninth month it entered Kui, reaching Bond and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: it entered Kui, reached Bond, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 孛者，孛亂之氣也。

translations.literal: A broom star is the qi of broom-like disorder.
translations.idiomatic: A broom star is vapor of sweeping disorder.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵喪並起，國大亂易政，大臣誅。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Warfare and mourning both rise; the state falls into great disorder and changes government; great ministers are executed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "War and mourning together; state chaos, regime change, and executed ministers follow."

sentences.zh: 」其後，太上皇崩。

translations.literal: Afterward the Retired Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the retired emperor died.

sentences.zh: 至武平二年七月，領軍庫狄伏連、治書侍御史王子宜，受琅邪王儼旨，矯詔誅錄尚書、淮南王和士開于南台，伏連等即日伏誅，右僕射馮子琮賜死。

translations.literal: By Wuping second year, seventh month, Army Commander Kudi Fulian, Palace Secretary Wang Ziyi, obeying Prince Langya Yan's forged edict, executed Recorder of the Secretariat Prince Huai of Huainan He Shikai at the Southern Terrace; Fulian and others were executed the same day, Vice Director Feng Zicong was ordered to commit suicide.
translations.idiomatic: By Wuping second year, seventh month, Kudi Fulian and Wang Ziyi, obeying Prince Langya Yan, forged an edict and executed He Shikai at the Southern Terrace; they were executed the same day and Feng Zicong was forced to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 此國亂之應也。

translations.literal: This was the response to national disorder.
translations.idiomatic: This fulfilled the omen of national disorder.

sentences.zh: 五年二月戊辰，歲星逆行，掩太微上將。

translations.literal: Fifth year, second month, wuchen day—Jupiter moved retrograde, masking the Upper General of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, second month, wuchen: Jupiter retrograded, occulting the Supreme Palace's Upper General.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下大驚，四輔有誅者。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great alarm throughout the realm; among the Four Supports there are those executed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The realm is greatly alarmed; one of the Four Supports is executed."

sentences.zh: 」五月甲午，熒惑犯鬼積屍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiawu day—Mars violated the Ghost Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiawu: Mars crossed the Ghost Heap of Corpses.

sentences.zh: 甲，齊也。

translations.literal: Jia—Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Jia marks Qi.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣誅，兵大起，斧質用，有大喪。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great ministers are executed; armies rise on a great scale; the axe is used; there is great mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Ministers executed, vast armies, the axe used, great mourning."

sentences.zh: 」至武平二年九月，誅琅邪王儼，三年五月，誅右丞相、咸陽王斛律明月，四年七月，誅蘭陵王長恭，皆懿親名將也。

translations.literal: By Wuping second year, ninth month, Prince Langya Yan was executed; third year, fifth month, Right Chancellor Prince Xianyang of Xianyang Hulu Yueguang was executed; fourth year, seventh month, Prince Langya of Langya Gao Changgong was executed—all close kin and famed generals.
translations.idiomatic: By Wuping second year, ninth month, Prince Langya Yan was executed; third year fifth month Hulu Yueguang; fourth year seventh month Gao Changgong—all royal kin and famed generals.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，又誅崔季舒等，此斧質用之應也。

translations.literal: Fourth year, tenth month, Cui Jishu and others were also executed—the response to use of the axe.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, tenth month, Cui Jishu and others were executed—fulfilling the axe omen.

sentences.zh: 武平三年八月癸未，填星、歲星、太白合于氐，宋之分野。

translations.literal: Wuping third year, eighth month, guiwei day—Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus conjoined in Dipper, Song's territorial division.
translations.idiomatic: Wuping third year, eighth month, guiwei: Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus conjoined in Dipper, Song's division.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其國內外有兵喪，改立侯王。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Within and without that state there is military mourning; marquis-kings are changed and enthroned."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "War and mourning at home and abroad; marquis-kings replaced."

sentences.zh: 」其四年十月，陳將吳明徹寇彭城，右僕射崔季舒，國子祭酒張雕，黃門裴澤、郭遵，尚書左丞封孝琰等，諫車駕不宜北幸并州。

translations.literal: Fourth year, tenth month, Chen general Wu Mingche invaded Pengcheng; Vice Director Cui Jishu, Grand Master of the National University Zhang Diao, Yellow Gate Pei Ze and Guo Zun, Left Assistant Minister of the Secretariat Feng Xiaoyan, and others remonstrated that the emperor should not travel north to Bingzhou; the Emperor in anger executed them all—the response to military mourning within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, tenth month, Wu Mingche invaded Pengcheng; Cui Jishu, Zhang Diao, Pei Ze, Guo Zun, and Feng Xiaoyan urged the emperor not to go north to Bingzhou; he executed them all—fulfilling war and mourning at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，並誅之，內外兵喪之應也。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengshen day—the moon was in Bond; the eclipse was total, not recovering until dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengshen: the moon in Bond; total eclipse until dawn.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，月在婁，食既，至旦不復。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The chief consort is ill-fated."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The chief consort faces ill fortune."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主凶。

translations.literal: Third year, eighth month, Empress Hulu was deposed and Empress Mu was enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, eighth month, Empress Hulu was deposed and Empress Mu enthroned.

sentences.zh: 」其三年八月，廢斛律皇后，立穆後。

translations.literal: Fourth year, Empress Hu was again deposed as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, Empress Hu was deposed to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 四年，又廢胡後為庶人。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yihai day—the Heavenly Dog descended in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yihai: the Heavenly Dog descended in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，天狗下西北。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Below there is great battle and flowing blood."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great battle and flowing blood follow below."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其下有大戰流血。

translations.literal: Afterward Zhou Wudi attacked Jinzhou and advanced to pacify Bingzhou—great battle and flowing blood.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou Wudi attacked Jinzou and pacified Bingzhou—great battle and bloodshed.

sentences.zh: 」後周武帝攻晉州，進兵平并州，大戰流血。

translations.literal: Third year, twelfth month, xinchou day—solar eclipse of Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, twelfth month, xinchou: solar eclipse of Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月辛丑，日食歲星。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is loss of a state."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "A state falls."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有亡國。

translations.literal: By the seventh year, Qi perished.
translations.idiomatic: By the seventh year, Qi fell.

sentences.zh: 」至七年，而齊亡。

translations.literal: Fourth year, fifth month, guisi day—Mars violated the Right Law-enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, fifth month, guisi: Mars crossed the Right Law-enforcer.

sentences.zh: 四年五月癸巳，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great generals die; law-enforcers are executed; if there is guilt."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great generals die; law-enforcers executed for guilt."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大將死，執法者誅，若有罪。

translations.literal: That year Right Chancellor Hulu Yueguang was executed; the next year Prince Langya of Langya Gao Changgong; the year after, Vice Director Cui Jishu—all responses to death of great generals and execution of law-enforcers.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hulu Yueguang was executed; next year Gao Changgong; the year after Cui Jishu—all fulfilling the omen of dead generals and executed law-enforcers.

sentences.zh: 」其年，誅右丞相斛律明月，明年，誅蘭陵王長恭，後年，誅右僕射崔季舒，皆大將死，執法誅之應也。

translations.literal: Zhou, Emperor Min first year, fifth month, guimao day—Venus violated the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou, Emperor Min first year, fifth month, guimao: Venus crossed the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 周閔帝元年五月癸卯，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Venus moving within the Chariot—great ministers issue orders."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Venus in the Chariot: great ministers issue orders."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太白行軒轅中，大臣出令。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The empress loses power."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The empress loses power."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「皇后失勢。

translations.literal: Xinhai day—Mars violated the second star at the north end of the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhai: Mars crossed the second star at the Eastern Well's north end.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，熒惑犯東井北端第二星。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "That state is in disorder."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "That state falls into disorder."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其國亂。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Great drought."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Great drought follows."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「大旱。

translations.literal: That year, ninth month, Regent Hu forced the Emperor to abdicate, confined him in the old residence, killed him after a month and more; Director of Conventions Li Zhi, Army Marshal Sun Heng, and Palace Attendant Yifu Feng were executed.
translations.idiomatic: That year, ninth month, Regent Hu forced abdication, confined the emperor, and killed him after a month; Li Zhi, Sun Heng, and Yifu Feng were executed.

sentences.zh: 」其年九月，塚宰護逼帝遜位，幽于舊邸，月餘殺崩，司會李植、軍司馬孫恆及宮伯乙弗鳳等被誅害。

translations.literal: That winter there was great drought—all responses to great ministers issuing orders, death of great ministers, and drought.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought great drought—fulfilling ministers seizing power, ministerial deaths, and drought.

sentences.zh: 其冬大旱。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming second year, third month, jiawu day—Mars entered the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming second year, third month, jiawu: Mars entered the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 皆大臣出令、大臣死、旱之應也。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Kings detest it; the chief consort is ill-fated."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Kings dread it; the chief consort is doomed."

sentences.zh: 明帝二年三月甲午，熒惑入軒轅。

translations.literal: That month, Empress Dowager Dugu died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Empress Dowager Dugu died.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「王者惡之，女主凶。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengzi day—Saturn violated the Well Halberd and conjoined with Venus.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengzi: Saturn crossed the Well Halberd and conjoined Venus.

sentences.zh: 」其月，王后獨孤氏崩。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Injury completed by the halberd; the ruler has one who dies by execution."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The halberd completes the killing; the ruler loses men to execution."

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，填星犯井鉞，與太白並。

translations.literal: That year, Grand Preceptor Yuwen Hu was poisoned while presenting food and the Emperor died of it.
translations.idiomatic: That year Grand Preceptor Yuwen Hu was poisoned at a meal and the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「傷成於鉞，君有戮死者。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu, Baoding first year, ninth month, yisi day—a guest star appeared at Wings.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu, Baoding first year, ninth month, yisi: a guest star appeared at Wings.

sentences.zh: 」其年，太師宇文護進食，帝遇毒崩。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiaxu day—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiaxu: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 武帝保定元年九月乙巳，客星見於翼。

translations.literal: Wuyin day—Mars violated the Upper General of the Supreme Palace and conjoined as one.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyin: Mars crossed the Supreme Palace's Upper General and merged with it.

sentences.zh: 十月甲戌，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second year, intercalary first month, guisi day—Venus entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, intercalary first month, guisi: Venus entered the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，熒惑犯太微上將，合為一。

translations.literal: Second month, renyin day—Mars violated the Upper Minister of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renyin: Mars crossed the Supreme Palace's Upper Minister.

sentences.zh: 二年閏正月癸巳，太白入昴。

translations.literal: Third month, renwu day—Mars violated the Left Law-enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renwu: Mars crossed the Left Law-enforcer.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，熒惑犯太微上相。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yihai day—Venus violated the Chariot Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yihai: Venus crossed the Chariot Ghost.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuchen day—solar eclipse, total.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuchen: total solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 七月乙亥，太白犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renwu day—Mars violated Jupiter south of Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renwu: Mars crossed Jupiter south of Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，日有食之，既。

translations.literal: Third year, third month, yichou new moon—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, third month, yichou new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，熒惑犯歲星于危南。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiazi day—Mars violated the Upper General of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiazi: Mars crossed the Supreme Palace's Upper General.

sentences.zh: 三年三月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The upper general is executed and dies."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The upper general is executed."

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，熒惑犯太微上將。

translations.literal: Tenth month, renchen day—Mars violated the Left Law-enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renchen: Mars crossed the Left Law-enforcer.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「上將誅死。

translations.literal: Fourth year, second month, gengyin new moon—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, second month, gengyin new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 」十月壬辰，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: Jiawu day—Mars violated the right side-horse of Room.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu: Mars crossed Room's right side-horse.

sentences.zh: 四年二月庚寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, jiwei day—Mars again violated the right side-horse of Room.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiwei: Mars again crossed Room's right side-horse.

sentences.zh: 甲午，熒惑犯房右驂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The upper minister is executed; chariots rush and men flee; warfare rises throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Upper minister executed; chariots flee; war engulfs the realm."

sentences.zh: 三月己未，熒惑又犯房右驂。

translations.literal: That year, tenth month, Regent Duke of Jin Hu led an army to attack Qi.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tenth month, Duke of Jin Hu led an army against Qi.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「上相誅，車馳人走，天下兵起。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Pillar of State Prince Yong of Yong Wang Xiong died fighting fiercely; the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, Wang Xiong, Prince of Yong, died fighting; the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 」其年十月，塚宰晉公護率軍伐齊。

translations.literal: The response to armies rising and generals dying.
translations.idiomatic: Fulfillment of war rising and generals dying.

sentences.zh: 十二月，柱國、庸公王雄力戰死之，遂班師。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dinghai, new moon—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dinghai new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 兵起將死之應也。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, xinmao day—a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, first month, xinmao: a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Warfare and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "War and mourning follow."

sentences.zh: 五年正月辛卯，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Jiachen day—Venus, Mars, and Jupiter conjoined in Bond.
translations.idiomatic: Jiachen: Venus, Mars, and Jupiter conjoined in Bond.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為兵喪。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengshen day—a comet issued from the Three Platforms, entered Literary Refinement, violated the Upper General, then passed the western wall of the Purple Palace into Rooftop, gradually lengthening to over one zhang, pointing toward Room and Wall; after a hundred-odd days it gradually shortened to two chi five cun and vanished in Void and Rooftop—Qi's territorial division.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengshen: a comet from the Three Platforms crossed Literary Refinement and the Upper General, passed the Purple Palace's western wall into Rooftop, grew to over a zhang pointing at Room and Wall, then shrank and vanished in Void and Rooftop—Qi's division.

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，太白、熒惑、歲星合于婁。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinsi, new moon—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinsi new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，慧星出三台，入文昌，犯上將，後經紫宮西垣入危，漸長一丈餘，指室壁，後百餘日稍短，長二尺五寸，在虛危滅，齊之分野。

translations.literal: Tianhe first year, first month, jimao day—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Tianhe first year, first month, jimao: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, yimao day—Venus visible by day, crossing the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yimao: Venus visible by day, crossing the meridian.

sentences.zh: 天和元年正月己卯，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, guiyou new moon—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, first month, guiyou new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jichou day—Jupiter and Mars conjoined at Well, about five chi apart.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jichou: Jupiter and Mars conjoined at Well, five chi apart.

sentences.zh: 二年，正月癸酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Both were Qin's division.
translations.idiomatic: Both marked Qin's territorial division.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，歲星與熒惑合在井宿，相去五尺。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "That state has armies; famine and drought; great ministers harbor secret plots; below there are rebels; perhaps loss of territory."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Armies, famine, drought, ministerial plots, rebels below, lost territory."

sentences.zh: 並為秦分。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, dingyou day—Jupiter and Venus conjoined at Willow, about one chi seven cun apart.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary sixth month, dingyou: Jupiter and Venus conjoined at Willow, one chi seven cun apart.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其國有兵，為饑旱，大臣匿謀，下有反者，若亡地。

translations.literal: Willow is Zhou's division.
translations.idiomatic: Willow marks Zhou's division.

sentences.zh: 」閏六月丁酉，歲星、太白合，在柳，相去一尺七寸。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Internal warfare."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Internal warfare follows."

sentences.zh: 柳為周分。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The ruler is ill-fated and grieves; cities are lost."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The ruler grieves; cities are lost."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為內兵。

translations.literal: That year, Hua Jiao, Inspector of Xiangzhou of Chen, led troops to surrender; Duke of Wei Zhi was sent with an army to aid him and then marched south.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chen's Xiangzhou inspector Hua Jiao surrendered; Duke of Wei Zhi marched south to aid him.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「主人凶憂，失城。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Duke of Wei Zhi fought Chen general Chunyu Liang at Dunhou; the royal army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, Duke of Wei Zhi lost to Chunyu Liang at Dunhou.

sentences.zh: 」是歲，陳湘州刺史華皎率眾來附，遣衛公直將兵援之，因而南伐。

translations.literal: Yuan Ding and Wei Shichong crossed first with several thousand foot and horse and were lost in Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Ding and Wei Shichong crossed ahead with thousands of troops and were lost in Chen.

sentences.zh: 九月，衛公直與陳將淳于量戰於沌口，王師失利。

translations.literal: Seventh month, gengxu day—Venus violated the great star of the Chariot, about seven cun apart.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengxu: Venus crossed the Chariot's great star, seven cun apart.

sentences.zh: 元定、韋世衝以步騎數千先度，遂沒陳。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The chief consort loses power; great ministers bear it."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The chief consort loses power; great ministers suffer for it."

sentences.zh: 七月庚戌，太白犯軒轅大星，相去七寸。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) It is also said: "Calamity rises in the west."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Disaster rises in the west."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主失勢，大臣當之。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Eleventh month, guichou day, Grand Guardian Duke of Xu Yuwen Gui died—the verification of great ministers bearing it.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guichou, Grand Guardian Yuwen Gui died—fulfilling the omen of ministers bearing calamity.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「西方禍起。

translations.literal: Tenth month, xinmao day—there was one black vapor, as large as a cup, in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinmao: black vapor the size of a cup appeared in the sun.

sentences.zh: 」其十一月癸丑，太保、許公宇文貴薨，大臣當之驗也。

translations.literal: Jiawu day—another was added; after six days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu: another appeared; after six days both vanished.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，有黑氣一，大如杯，在日中。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Ministers obscure the ruler's brightness."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Ministers obscure the ruler's light."

sentences.zh: 甲午，又加一，經六日乃滅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuxu new moon—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuxu new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「臣有蔽主之明者。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Ministers obscure the ruler's brightness."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Ministers obscure the ruler's light."

sentences.zh: 」十一月戊戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Eleventh month, wuxu new moon—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuxu new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚子，熒惑犯鉤鈐，去之六寸。

translations.literal: Gengzi day—Mars violated the Hooked Clasp, six cun from it.
translations.idiomatic: Gengzi: Mars crossed the Hooked Clasp, six cun away.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「王者有憂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Kings have sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Kings face sorrow."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「車騎驚，三公謀。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Chariots and cavalry are alarmed; the Three Dukes plot."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Chariots and cavalry alarmed; the Three Dukes plot."

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.)
translations.idiomatic: (This closes the omen text cited above.)

sentences.zh: 三年三月己未，太白犯井北轅第一星。

translations.literal: Third year, third month, jiwei day—Venus violated the first star of the north axle of the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, third month, jiwei: Venus crossed the Well's north axle first star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「將軍惡之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Generals detest it."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Generals dread this omen."

sentences.zh: 」其七月壬寅，隋公楊忠薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renyin day, Duke of Sui Yang Zhong died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renyin: Duke of Sui Yang Zhong died.

sentences.zh: 四月辛巳，太白入輿鬼，犯積屍。

translations.literal: Fourth month, xinsi day—Venus entered the Chariot Ghost and violated the Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinsi: Venus entered the Chariot Ghost and crossed the Heap of Corpses.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣誅。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great ministers are executed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great ministers are executed."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「亂臣在內，有屠城。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Rebellious ministers within; there is slaughter of a city."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Rebels within; a city is sacked."

sentences.zh: 」六月甲戌，彗見東井，長一丈，上白下赤而銳，漸東行，至七月癸卯，在鬼北八寸所乃滅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiaxu day—a comet appeared at the Eastern Well, one zhang long, white above and red below and sharp, gradually moving east; by seventh month, guimao, it was eight cun north of the Ghost and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiaxu: a comet at the Eastern Well, one zhang, white above and red below, moved east; seventh month, guimao, it vanished north of the Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為兵，國政崩壞。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Warfare; state government collapses."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "War; government collapses."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「將軍死，大臣誅。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Generals die; great ministers are executed."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Generals die; ministers executed."

sentences.zh: 」七月己未，客星見房心，白如粉絮，大如斗，漸大，東行；

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiwei day—a guest star appeared at Heart, white like cotton fluff, as large as a dou, gradually growing, moving east;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiwei: a guest star at Heart, white as cotton, dou-sized, growing, moving east;

sentences.zh: 八月，入天市，長如匹所，複東行，犯河鼓右將；

translations.literal: Eighth month, it entered the Celestial Market, as long as a bolt of cloth, again moving east, violating the Right General of the Drum;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: it entered the Celestial Market, cloth-length, moving east, crossing the Drum's Right General;

sentences.zh: 癸未，犯瓠瓜，又入室，犯離宮；

translations.literal: Guiwei day, it violated Gourd, again entering Room, violating the Detached Palace;
translations.idiomatic: Guiwei: it crossed Gourd, entered Room, violating the Detached Palace;

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，入奎，稍小；

translations.literal: Ninth month, renyin, it entered Kui, gradually shrinking;
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renyin: it entered Kui and shrank;

sentences.zh: 壬戌，至婁北一尺所滅。

translations.literal: Renxu day, one chi north of Bond it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Renxu: it vanished one chi north of Bond.

sentences.zh: 凡六十九日。

translations.literal: In all, sixty-nine days.
translations.idiomatic: It lasted sixty-nine days in all.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵起，若有喪，白衣會，為饑旱，國易政。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Armies rise; if there is mourning, a gathering in white, famine and drought, the state changes government."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Armies rise; mourning, white-robed gatherings, famine, drought, regime change."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「兵犯外城，大臣誅。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Armies violate the outer wall; great ministers are executed."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Armies breach outer walls; ministers executed."

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.)
translations.idiomatic: (This closes the omen text cited above.)

sentences.zh: 四年二月戊辰，歲星逆行，掩太微上將。

translations.literal: Fourth year, second month, wuchen day—Jupiter moved retrograde, masking the Upper General of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, second month, wuchen: Jupiter retrograded, occulting the Supreme Palace's Upper General.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下大驚，國不安，四輔有誅，必有兵革，天下大赦。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great alarm throughout the realm; the state is unsettled; among the Four Supports there are executions; armies and revolt are certain; a great amnesty throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Realm alarmed, state unsettled, Four Supports executed, war certain, great amnesty."

sentences.zh: 」庚午，有流星，大如斗，出左攝提，流至天津滅，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Gengwu day—there was a meteor as large as a dou, issuing from Left Sheti, flowing to Celestial Ford and vanishing, with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Gengwu: a dou-sized meteor from Left Sheti flowed to Celestial Ford and vanished with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，熒惑犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guisi day—Mars violated the Chariot Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guisi: Mars crossed the Chariot Ghost.

sentences.zh: 甲午，犯積屍。

translations.literal: Jiawu day—it violated the Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu: it crossed the Heap of Corpses.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「午，秦也。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Wu is Qin."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Wu marks Qin."

sentences.zh: 大臣有誅，兵大起。

translations.literal: Great ministers are executed; armies rise on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: Great ministers are executed; armies rise on a vast scale.

sentences.zh: 」後三年，太師、大塚宰、晉國公宇文護以不臣誅，皆其應也。

translations.literal: Three years later, Grand Preceptor and Grand Regent Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu was executed for disloyalty—all responses.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later Grand Preceptor Yuwen Hu was executed for treason—all as foretold.

sentences.zh: 五年正月乙巳，月在氐，暈，有白虹長丈所貫之，而有兩珥連接，規北斗第四星。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, yisi day—the moon was in Dipper with a halo; a white rainbow about a zhang long pierced it, with two ear-pendants linked, encircling the fourth star of the Big Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, first month, yisi: the moon in Dipper with a halo; a one-zhang white rainbow pierced it with two linked ear-pendants encircling the Big Dipper's fourth star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵大起，大戰，將軍死于野。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Armies rise on a great scale; great battle; generals die in the field."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Vast armies, great battle, generals dead in the field."

sentences.zh: 」是冬，齊將斛律明月寇邊，於汾北築城，自華谷至於龍門。

translations.literal: That winter, Qi general Hulu Yueguang raided the border and built a wall on the north of the Fen from Huagu to Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Qi general Hulu Yueguang raided the border and built a wall north of the Fen from Huagu to Longmen.

sentences.zh: 其明年正月，詔齊公憲率師禦之。

translations.literal: The next year, first month, an edict ordered Duke of Qi Xian to lead troops against him.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, first month, Duke of Qi Xian was ordered to lead troops against him.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，憲自龍門度河，攻拔其新築五城，兵起大戰之應也。

translations.literal: Third month, jiyou day, Xian crossed the Yellow River at Longmen and stormed five newly built cities—the response to armies rising and great battle.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiyou, Xian crossed at Longmen and took five new fortresses—fulfilling war and great battle.

sentences.zh: 六年二月己丑夜，有蒼雲，廣三丈，經天，自戌加辰。

translations.literal: Sixth year, second month, jichou night—there was green cloud three zhang wide spanning heaven from xu through chen.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, second month, jichou night: green cloud three zhang wide spanned heaven from xu through chen.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, wuyin new moon—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuyin new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，熒惑逆行，犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Jimao day—Mars moved retrograde and violated the Chariot Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Jimao: Mars retrograded and crossed the Chariot Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有兵喪，大臣誅，兵大起。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Warfare and mourning; great ministers executed; armies rise on a great scale."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "War, mourning, executed ministers, vast armies."

sentences.zh: 」其月，又率師取齊宜陽等九城。

translations.literal: That month, troops again took nine cities including Yiyang of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: That month troops again took nine Qi cities including Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 六月，齊將攻陷汾州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Qi general attacked and captured Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, a Qi general captured Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，熒惑太白合，在張宿，相去一尺。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengchen day—Mars and Venus conjoined at Extended Net, about one chi apart.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengchen: Mars and Venus conjoined at Extended Net, one chi apart.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「主人兵不勝，所合國有殃。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The home army cannot win; the state where they conjoin suffers calamity."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The home army cannot win; the conjoined state suffers calamity."

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.)
translations.idiomatic: (This closes the omen text cited above.)

sentences.zh: 建德元年三月丙辰，熒惑、太白合壁。

translations.literal: Jiande first year, third month, bingchen day—Mars and Venus conjoined at Wall.
translations.idiomatic: Jiande first year, third month, bingchen: Mars and Venus conjoined at Wall.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其分有兵喪，不可舉事，用兵必受其殃。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "That division has military mourning; one must not undertake affairs; using armies is certain to suffer calamity."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "That quarter faces war and mourning; do not act; armies will suffer."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「改立侯王，有德者興，無德者亡。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Marquis-kings are changed; the virtuous rise, the unvirtuous perish."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Marquis-kings replaced; the virtuous rise, the wicked fall."

sentences.zh: 」其月，誅晉公護、護子譚公會、莒公至、崇業公靜等，大赦。

translations.literal: That month, Duke of Jin Hu, Duke of Tan Gonghui, Duke of Ju Gongzhi, Duke of Chongye Gongjing, and others were executed; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: That month Duke of Jin Hu and his sons were executed; general amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔以齊公憲為大塚宰，是其驗也。

translations.literal: Guihai day, an edict appointed Duke of Qi Xian as Grand Regent—the verification.
translations.idiomatic: Guihai: Duke of Qi Xian was appointed Grand Regent—the fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 七月丙午，辰與太白合于井，相去七寸。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingwu day—Chronos and Venus conjoined at Well, seven cun apart.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingwu: Chronos and Venus conjoined at Well, seven cun apart.

sentences.zh: 占曰；

translations.literal: Interpretation says:
translations.idiomatic: The reading says:

sentences.zh: 「其下之國，必有重德致天下。

translations.literal: "The state below will certainly bring heavy virtue and win the realm."
translations.idiomatic: "The state below will win the realm through heavy virtue."

sentences.zh: 」後四年，上帥師平齊，致天下之應也。

translations.literal: Four years later the Emperor led troops and pacified Qi—fulfillment of winning the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later the emperor conquered Qi—fulfilling the omen of winning the realm.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，月犯心中星，相去一寸。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiyou day—the moon violated the central star of the Heart, one cun apart.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiyou: the moon crossed the Heart's central star, one cun apart.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「亂臣在傍，不出五年，下有亡國。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Rebellious ministers at the side; within five years below there is loss of a state."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Rebels at the ruler's side; within five years a state falls."

sentences.zh: 」後周武伐齊，平之，有亡國之應也。

translations.literal: Afterward Zhou Wu attacked Qi and pacified it—the response to loss of a state.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou Wudi conquered Qi—fulfilling the fallen-state omen.

sentences.zh: 二年二月辛亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, xinhai day—a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, second month, xinhai: a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「臣謀君，不出三年。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Ministers plot against the ruler; within three years."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Ministers plot against the ruler; within three years."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「近臣為亂。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Close ministers raise disorder."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Close ministers raise disorder."

sentences.zh: 」後年七月，衛王直在京師舉兵反。

translations.literal: The next year, seventh month, Prince of Wei Zhi raised troops in the capital in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, seventh month, Prince of Wei Zhi rebelled in the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，熒惑掩鬼西北星。

translations.literal: Guihai day—Mars masked the northwest star of the Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Guihai: Mars occulted the Ghost's northwest star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大賊在大人之側。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great bandits are at the great man's side."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great bandits stand beside the great man."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「大臣有誅。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Great ministers are executed."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Great ministers are executed."

sentences.zh: 」四月己亥，太白掩西北星，壬寅，又掩東北星。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jihai day—Venus masked the northwest star; renyin day, it again masked the northeast star.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jihai: Venus occulted the northwest star; renyin, the northeast star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國有憂，大臣誅。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The state has sorrow; great ministers are executed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The state grieves; ministers executed."

sentences.zh: 」六月丙辰，月犯心中後二星。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingchen day—the moon violated the second and third stars behind the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingchen: the moon crossed the second and third stars behind the Heart.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「亂臣在傍，不出三年，有亡國。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Rebellious ministers at the side; within three years there is loss of a state."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Rebels at the side; within three years a state falls."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「人主惡之。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The ruler detests it."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The ruler dreads it."

sentences.zh: 」九月癸酉，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: September guiyou day—Venus violated the Left Law-enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: September guiyou: Venus crossed the Left Law-enforcer.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣有憂，執法者誅，若有罪。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great ministers have sorrow; law-enforcers are executed, if there is guilt."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Ministers grieve; law-enforcers executed for guilt."

sentences.zh: 」十一月壬子，太白掩填星，在尾。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renzi day—Venus masked Saturn in Tail.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renzi: Venus occulted Saturn in Tail.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「填星為女主，尾為後宮。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Saturn is the chief consort; Tail is the inner palace."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Saturn is the chief consort; Tail is the inner palace."

sentences.zh: 」明年皇太后崩。

translations.literal: The next year the Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: Next year the empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 三年二月戊午，客星大如桃，青白色，出五車東南三尺所，漸東行，稍長二尺所；

translations.literal: Third year, second month, wuwu day—a guest star as large as a peach, green-white, three chi south of the Five Chariots, gradually moving east, lengthening to about two chi;
translations.idiomatic: Third year, second month, wuwu: a peach-sized green-white guest star three chi south of the Five Chariots moved east, growing to two chi;

sentences.zh: 至四月壬辰，入文昌；

translations.literal: By fourth month, renchen, it entered Literary Refinement;
translations.idiomatic: By fourth month, renchen, it entered Literary Refinement;

sentences.zh: 丁未，入北斗魁中，後出魁，漸小。

translations.literal: Dingwei day, it entered the Dipper's handle, then exited the handle and gradually shrank.
translations.idiomatic: Dingwei: it entered the Dipper's handle, exited, and shrank.

sentences.zh: 凡見九十三日。

translations.literal: In all it was visible ninety-three days.
translations.idiomatic: It was visible ninety-three days in all.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下兵起，車騎滿野，人主有憂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Warfare rises throughout the realm; chariots and cavalry fill the fields; the ruler has sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "War engulfs the realm; cavalry fills the fields; the ruler grieves."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「天下有亂，兵大起，臣謀主。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Disorder throughout the realm; armies rise on a great scale; ministers plot against the ruler."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Realm-wide disorder, vast armies, ministers plot against the throne."

sentences.zh: 」其七月乙酉，衛王直在京師舉兵反，討擒之，廢為庶人。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yiyou day, Prince of Wei Zhi raised troops in the capital in rebellion, was captured and deposed as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yiyou, Prince of Wei Zhi rebelled in the capital, was captured and deposed.

sentences.zh: 至十月，始州民王鞅擁眾反，討平之。

translations.literal: By tenth month, the people of Shizhou, Wang Yang, gathered a host in rebellion and were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: By tenth month Wang Yang of Shizhou rebelled and was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 四月乙卯，星孛于紫宮垣外，大如拳，赤白，指五帝座，漸東南行，稍長一丈五尺；

translations.literal: Fourth month, yimao day—a broom star outside the Purple Palace wall, as large as a fist, red-white, pointing at the Five Emperors' Seat, gradually moving southeast, lengthening to one zhang five chi;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yimao: a fist-sized red-white broom star outside the Purple Palace wall pointed at the Five Emperors' Seat, moving southeast to one zhang five chi;

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，至上臺北滅。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiazi day, it vanished north of the Upper Platform.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiazi: it vanished north of the Upper Platform.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下易政，無德者亡。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The realm changes government; the unvirtuous perish."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Regime change; the wicked perish."

sentences.zh: 」後二年，武帝率六軍滅齊。

translations.literal: Two years later the Emperor led the Six Armies and destroyed Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later the emperor destroyed Qi with the Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，歲星與太白相犯，光芒相及，在危。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingzi day—Jupiter and Venus mutually violated each other, their lights touching, in Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingzi: Jupiter and Venus clashed, lights touching, in Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其野兵，人主凶，失其城邑。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Armies in that region; the ruler is ill-fated; cities and towns are lost."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Armies in that quarter; the ruler doomed; cities lost."

sentences.zh: 危，齊之分野。

translations.literal: Rooftop is Qi's territorial division.
translations.idiomatic: Rooftop marks Qi's division.

sentences.zh: 」後二年，宇文神舉攻拔陸渾等五城。

translations.literal: Two years later, Yuwen Shenju stormed five cities including Luhun.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Yuwen Shenju took five cities including Luhun.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，月犯歲星，在危，相去二寸。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengyin day—the moon violated Jupiter in Rooftop, two cun apart.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengyin: the moon crossed Jupiter in Rooftop, two cun apart.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其邦流亡，不出三年。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "That state's people wander in exile; within three years."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "That state's people wander in exile; within three years."

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，月行在營室，食太白。

translations.literal: Xinmao day—the moon moved in Encampment, eclipsing Venus.
translations.idiomatic: Xinmao: the moon in Encampment eclipsed Venus.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其國以兵亡，將軍戰死。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "That state perishes by armies; generals die in battle."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "That state falls by war; generals die in battle."

sentences.zh: 營室，衛也，地在齊境。

translations.literal: Encampment is Wei; the territory is in Qi's border.
translations.idiomatic: Encampment is Wei; the territory lies in Qi's border.

sentences.zh: 」後齊亡入周。

translations.literal: Afterward Qi perished and entered Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Qi fell and was absorbed into Zhou.

sentences.zh: 四年三月甲子，月犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Fourth year, third month, jiazi day—the moon violated the great star of the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, third month, jiazi: the moon crossed the Chariot's great star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主有憂，又五官有亂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The chief consort has sorrow; moreover the Five Offices are in disorder."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The chief consort grieves; the Five Offices fall into disorder."

translations.literal: (End of passage.)
translations.idiomatic: (End of this section of omen records.)

sentences.zh: 五年十月庚戌，熒惑犯太微西蕃上將星。

translations.literal: Fifth year, tenth month, gengxu day—Mars violated the Upper General star of the western rampart of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, tenth month, gengxu: Mars crossed the Supreme Palace western rampart's Upper General.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下不安，上將誅，若有罪，其止。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Unrest throughout the realm; the upper general is executed, if there is guilt, it stops."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Realm unsettled; upper general executed for guilt, then it ends."

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.)
translations.idiomatic: (This closes the omen text cited above.)

sentences.zh: 六年二月，皇太子巡撫西土，仍討吐谷渾。

translations.literal: Sixth year, second month—the crown prince toured the western regions and proceeded to attack Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, second month: the crown prince toured the west and attacked Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 八月，至伏俟城而旋。

translations.literal: Eighth month—he reached Fuqi city and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: he reached Fuqi city and returned.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾寇邊，天下不安之應也。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun raided the border—the response to unrest throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun raided the border—fulfilling the omen of realm-wide unrest.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，熒惑入鬼。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengwu day—Mars entered the Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengwu: Mars entered the Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有喪旱。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is mourning and drought."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Mourning and drought follow."

sentences.zh: 」其七月，京師旱。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the capital region suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, the capital region suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，歲星犯大陵。

translations.literal: Tenth month, wuwu day—Jupiter violated Great Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuwu: Jupiter crossed Great Tomb.

sentences.zh: 又己未、庚申，月連暈，規昴、畢、五車及參。

translations.literal: Also on jiwei and gengshen days—the moon had consecutive halos encircling the Pleiades, Net, Five Chariots, and Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Also jiwei and gengshen: the moon showed consecutive halos around the Pleiades, Net, Five Chariots, and Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵起爭地。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Armies rise contending for territory."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Armies rise fighting for land."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「王自將兵。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The king himself leads armies."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The king leads armies in person."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「天下大赦。

translations.literal: It is also said: "General amnesty throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "General amnesty throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，帝率眾攻晉州。

translations.literal: Guihai day—the Emperor led the host to attack Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guihai: the emperor led the host against Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 是日虹見晉州城上，首向南，尾入紫宮，長十餘丈。

translations.literal: That day a rainbow appeared above Jinzhou city, its head south and tail entering the Purple Palace, over ten zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: That day a rainbow arched above Jinzhou, head south and tail entering the Purple Palace, over ten zhang long.

sentences.zh: 庚午，克之。

translations.literal: Gengwu day—it was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Gengwu: the city was taken.

sentences.zh: 丁卯夜，白虹見，長十餘丈，頭在南，尾入紫宮中。

translations.literal: Dingmao night—a white rainbow appeared, over ten zhang long, head in the south and tail entering the Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Dingmao night: a white rainbow over ten zhang long, head south and tail in the Purple Palace.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其下兵戰流血。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Below there is military battle and flowing blood."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Battle and bloodshed follow below."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「若無兵，必有大喪。

translations.literal: It is also said: "If there is no army, there is certain to be great mourning."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Without armies, great mourning is certain."

sentences.zh: 」至六年正月，平齊，與齊軍大戰。

translations.literal: By sixth year, first month, Qi was pacified and a great battle was fought with Qi armies.
translations.idiomatic: By sixth year, first month, Qi was pacified after great battles.

sentences.zh: 十一月稽胡反，齊王討平之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month the Ji-hu rebelled; the Prince of Qi suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month the Ji-hu rebelled; the Prince of Qi suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，先此熒惑入太微宮二百日，犯東蕃上相，西蕃上將，句已往還。

translations.literal: Sixth year, fourth month, before this Mars had been in the Supreme Palace two hundred days, violating the eastern rampart Upper Minister and western rampart Upper General, moving back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, fourth month: before this Mars had spent two hundred days in the Supreme Palace, crossing eastern Upper Minister and western Upper General.

sentences.zh: 至此月甲子，出端門。

translations.literal: By this month, jiazi day, it exited the End Gate.
translations.idiomatic: This month, jiazi: it exited the End Gate.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為大臣代主。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great ministers replace the ruler."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great ministers replace the ruler."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「臣不臣，有反者。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Ministers are not ministers; there are rebels."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Ministers rebel; traitors appear."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「必有大喪。

translations.literal: It is also said: "There is certain to be great mourning."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Great mourning is certain."

sentences.zh: 」後宣、武繼崩，高祖以大運代起。

translations.literal: Afterward Emperors Xuan and Wu died in succession; Gaozu rose in the Great Succession.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Emperors Xuan and Wu died in turn; Sui Gaozu rose to power.

sentences.zh: 十月癸卯，月食，熒惑在斗。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guimao day—lunar eclipse; Mars was in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guimao: lunar eclipse; Mars in the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國敗，其君亡，兵大起，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The state is defeated, its ruler perishes; great armies rise; armies are broken and generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "State defeated, ruler dead, great war, shattered armies, slain generals."

sentences.zh: 斗為吳、越之星，陳之分野。

translations.literal: The Dipper is the star of Wu and Yue; Chen's territorial division.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper marks Wu and Yue—Chen's division.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，陳將吳明徹侵呂梁，徐州總管梁士彥出軍與戰，不利。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Chen general Wu Mingche invaded Lüliang; Xuzhou Inspector Liang Shiyan led troops to fight and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, Chen general Wu Mingche invaded Lüliang; Xuzhou inspector Liang Shiyan was defeated.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，郯公王軌討擒陳將吳明徹，俘斬三萬餘人。

translations.literal: Next year, third month, Duke of Teng Wang Gui captured Chen general Wu Mingche and beheaded over thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, third month, Wang Gui captured Wu Mingche and beheaded over thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，晡時，日中有黑子，大如杯。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiachen day, afternoon—the sun had black spots as large as a cup.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiachen, afternoon: black spots cup-sized appeared in the sun.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「君有過而臣不諫，人主惡之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The ruler has faults and ministers do not remonstrate; the ruler detests it."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The ruler errs while ministers stay silent—the ruler dreads this omen."

sentences.zh: 」十二月癸丑，流星大如月，西流有聲，蛇行屈曲，光照地。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guichou day—a meteor as large as the moon flowed west with sound, serpent-like and winding, its light shining on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guichou: a moon-sized meteor flowed west with sound, serpent-like, lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵大起，下有戰場。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Armies rise on a great scale; below there is a battlefield."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Vast armies rise; battlefields spread below."

sentences.zh: 」戌辰平旦，有流星大如三斗器，色赤，出紫宮，凝著天，乃北下。

translations.literal: Xuchen day at dawn—a meteor as large as a three-dou vessel, red in color, issued from the Purple Palace, fixed in heaven, then descended north.
translations.idiomatic: Xuchen dawn: a red three-dou meteor issued from the Purple Palace, hung in heaven, then fell north.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「人主去其宮殿。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The ruler leaves his palace."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The ruler leaves his palace."

sentences.zh: 」是月，營州刺史高寶甯據州反。

translations.literal: That month, Inspector of Yingzhou Gao Baoning held the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Gao Baoning, Inspector of Yingzhou, rebelled holding his province.

sentences.zh: 其明年五月，帝總戎北伐。

translations.literal: The next year, fifth month, the Emperor personally led a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, fifth month, the emperor led a northern campaign in person.

sentences.zh: 後年，武帝崩。

translations.literal: The year after, Emperor Wu died.
translations.idiomatic: The year after, Emperor Wu died.

sentences.zh: 宣政元年正月丙子，月食昴。

translations.literal: Xuanzheng first year, first month, bingzi day—lunar eclipse of the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzheng first year, first month, bingzi: lunar eclipse of the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有白衣之會。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is a gathering in white."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "A gathering of mourners in white follows."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「匈奴侵邊。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The Xiongnu invade the border."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The Xiongnu invade the border."

sentences.zh: 」其月，突厥寇幽州，殺略吏人。

translations.literal: That month, Turks raided Youzhou and killed and captured officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: That month Turks raided Youzhou, killing and capturing officials and people.

sentences.zh: 五月，帝總戎北伐。

translations.literal: Fifth month—the Emperor personally led a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: the emperor led a northern campaign in person.

sentences.zh: 六月，帝疾甚，還京，次雲陽而崩。

translations.literal: Sixth month—the Emperor grew gravely ill, returned to the capital, stopped at Yunyang and died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: the emperor fell gravely ill, returned, stopped at Yunyang, and died.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，癸丑，木火金三星合，在井。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renwu and guichou days—Wood, Fire, and Metal stars conjoined at the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renwu and guichou: Wood, Fire, and Metal stars conjoined at the Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其國霸。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "That state hegemonizes."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "That state achieves hegemony."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「其國外內有兵喪，改立侯王。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Within and without there is military mourning; marquis-kings are changed."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "War and mourning at home and abroad; marquis-kings replaced."

sentences.zh: 」是月，幽州人盧昌期據范陽反，改立王侯，兵喪之驗也。

translations.literal: That month, the people of Youzhou, Lu Changqi, held Fanyang in rebellion, changing and enthroning marquis-kings—the verification of armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: That month Lu Changqi of Youzhou rebelled at Fanyang and enthroned a rival king—fulfilling war and mourning.

sentences.zh: 七年辛丑，月犯心前星。

translations.literal: Seventh year, xinchou day—the moon violated the front star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, xinchou: the moon crossed the Heart's front star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太子惡之，若失位。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The crown prince detests it; perhaps loss of position."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The crown prince dreads it; he may lose his place."

sentences.zh: 」後靜帝立為天子，不終之徵也。

translations.literal: Afterward Emperor Jing was enthroned as Son of Heaven—a sign he would not finish his reign.
translations.idiomatic: Later Emperor Jing was enthroned—a sign his reign would not last.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，熒惑、太白合，在七星，相去二尺八寸所。

translations.literal: Bingchen day—Mars and Venus conjoined at Seven Stars, about two chi eight cun apart.
translations.idiomatic: Bingchen: Mars and Venus conjoined at Seven Stars, two chi eight cun apart.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「君憂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The ruler grieves."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The ruler grieves."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「其國有兵，改立王侯，有德興，無德亡。

translations.literal: It is also said: "That state has armies; marquis-kings are changed; the virtuous rise, the unvirtuous perish."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Armies rise; marquis-kings replaced; the virtuous rise, the wicked fall."

sentences.zh: 」後年，改署四輔官，傳位太子，改立王侯之應也。

translations.literal: The next year, the Four Supports offices were reorganized, the throne passed to the crown prince—responses to changing and enthroning marquis-kings.
translations.idiomatic: Next year the Four Supports were reorganized and the throne passed to the crown prince—fulfilling replaced marquis-kings.

sentences.zh: 己未，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Jiwei day—Venus violated the great star of the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Jiwei: Venus crossed the Chariot's great star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主凶。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The chief consort is ill-fated."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The chief consort is doomed."

sentences.zh: 」後二年，宣帝崩，楊後令其父隋公為大丞相，總軍國事。

translations.literal: Two years later Emperor Xuan died; Empress Yang had her father Duke of Sui Yang Jian made Grand Chancellor and director of military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Emperor Xuan died; Empress Yang made her father Yang Jian Grand Chancellor and regent.

sentences.zh: 隋氏受命，廢後為樂平公主，余四後悉廢為比丘尼。

translations.literal: Sui received the Mandate; the empress was demoted to Princess Leping; the other four empresses were all demoted to Buddhist nuns.
translations.idiomatic: Sui took the Mandate; the empress became Princess Leping; the other four empresses became nuns.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，太白入太微。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengchen day—Venus entered the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengchen: Venus entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為天下驚。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Alarm throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Alarm throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「近臣起兵，大臣相殺，國有憂。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Close ministers raise armies; great ministers mutually kill; the state has sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Close ministers rebel; ministers slay one another; the state grieves."

sentences.zh: 」其後，趙、陳等五王為執政所誅，大臣相殺之應也。

translations.literal: Afterward the five princes Zhao, Chen, and others were executed by the regent—responses to great ministers mutually killing.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Princes Zhao, Chen, and others were executed by the regent—fulfilling ministerial slaughter.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，熒惑入太微西掖門，庚申，犯左執法，相去三寸。
