translations.literal: Ninth month, dingyou day—Mars entered the Supreme Palace's western crotch gate; gengshen day, it violated the Left Law-enforcer, three cun apart.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingyou: Mars entered the Supreme Palace's western crotch gate; gengshen, it crossed the Left Law-enforcer, three cun apart.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下不安，大臣有憂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Unrest throughout the realm; great ministers have sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Realm unsettled; great ministers grieve."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「執法者誅若有罪。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Law-enforcers are executed if there is guilt."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Law-enforcers executed for guilt."

sentences.zh: 」是月，汾州稽胡反，討平之。

translations.literal: That month, Ji-hu rebelled in Fenzhou and were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ji-hu rebelled in Fenzhou and were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 十一月，突厥寇邊，圍酒泉，殺略吏人。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Turks raided the border, besieged Jiuquan, and killed and captured officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, Turks besieged Jiuquan and killed and captured officials and people.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，殺柱國、郯公王軌。

translations.literal: Next year, second month, Pillar of State Duke of Teng Wang Gui was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, second month, Wang Gui, Duke of Teng, was executed.

sentences.zh: 皆其應也。

translations.literal: All these were the responses.
translations.idiomatic: All were fulfilled as foretold.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，熒惑入氐，守犯之三十日。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guiwei day—Mars entered Dipper, guarding and violating it for thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiwei: Mars entered Dipper and guarded it for thirty days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子失其宮。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The Son of Heaven loses his palace."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The Son of Heaven loses his palace."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「賊臣在內，下有反者。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Treacherous ministers within; below there are rebels."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Traitors within; rebels below."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「國君有系饑死，若毒死者。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The ruler is imprisoned, starves to death, or dies by poison."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The ruler is imprisoned, starves, or is poisoned."

sentences.zh: 」靜帝禪位，隋高祖幽殺之。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing abdicated; Sui Gaozu had him secretly killed.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing abdicated; Sui Gaozu had him secretly killed.

sentences.zh: 宣帝大成元年正月丙午、癸丑，日皆有背。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan, Dacheng first year, first month, bingwu and guichou days—both days the sun had back-vapor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan, Dacheng first year, first month, bingwu and guichou: both days the sun showed back-vapor.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「臣為逆，有反叛，邊將去之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Ministers are rebellious; there is rebellion; border generals depart."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Ministers rebel; rebellion rises; border generals defect."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「卿大夫欲為主。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Ministers and grandees wish to become ruler."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Ministers and grandees seek the throne."

sentences.zh: 」其後，隋公作霸，尉迥、王謙、司馬消難各舉兵反。

translations.literal: Afterward Duke of Sui became hegemon; Wei Cong, Wang Qian, and Sima Xiaonan each raised armies in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Duke of Sui seized power; Wei Cong, Wang Qian, and Sima Xiaonan rebelled.

sentences.zh: 大象元年四月戊子，太白、歲星、辰星合，在井。

translations.literal: Daxiang first year, fourth month, wuzi day—Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury conjoined at the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Daxiang first year, fourth month, wuzi: Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury conjoined at the Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「是謂驚立，是謂絕行，其國內外有兵喪，改立王公。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "This is called alarmed establishment; this is called severed movement—in that state within and without there is military mourning; kings and dukes are changed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Alarmed establishment, severed movement—war and mourning at home and abroad; kings and dukes replaced."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「其國可霸，修德者強，無德受殃。

translations.literal: It is also said: "That state can hegemonize; those who cultivate virtue grow strong, those without virtue suffer calamity."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "That state may hegemonize; the virtuous grow strong, the wicked suffer."

sentences.zh: 」其五月，趙、陳、越、代、滕五王併入國。

translations.literal: Fifth month, the five princes Zhao, Chen, Yue, Dai, and Teng all entered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, the five princes Zhao, Chen, Yue, Dai, and Teng all entered the capital.

sentences.zh: 後二年，隋王受命，宇文氏宗族相繼誅滅。

translations.literal: Two years later Sui Wang received the Mandate; the Yuwen clan was executed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Sui received the Mandate; the Yuwen clan was systematically executed.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，有流星一，大如雞子，出氐中，西北流，有尾跡，長一丈所，入月中，即滅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingmao day—there was one meteor, as large as a chicken egg, issuing from Dipper, flowing northwest with a tail trace over one zhang, entering the moon and immediately vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingmao: an egg-sized meteor from Dipper flowed northwest with a one-zhang tail, entered the moon, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「不出三年，人主有憂。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Within three years the ruler has sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Within three years the ruler grieves."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「有亡國。

translations.literal: It is also said: "There is loss of a state."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "A state falls."

sentences.zh: 」靜帝幽閉之應也。

translations.literal: The response to Emperor Jing's confinement.
translations.idiomatic: Fulfillment of Emperor Jing's confinement.

sentences.zh: 己丑，有流星一，大如斗，色青，有光明照地，出營室，抵壁入濁。

translations.literal: Jichou day—there was one meteor as large as a dou, green in color, with bright light shining on the ground, issuing from Encampment, reaching Wall and entering Turbid Waters.
translations.idiomatic: Jichou: a green dou-sized meteor with bright ground-light issued from Encampment, reached Wall, and entered Turbid Waters.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，熒惑掩房北頭第一星。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renchen day—Mars masked the first star at the north head of Room.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renchen: Mars occulted Room's north head first star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「亡君之誡。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Warning of a perishing ruler."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Warning of a doomed ruler."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「將軍為亂，王者惡之，大臣有反者，天子憂。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Generals raise disorder; kings detest it; great ministers rebel; the Son of Heaven grieves."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Generals rebel; kings dread it; ministers betray; the Son of Heaven grieves."

sentences.zh: 」其十二月，帝親禦驛馬，日行三百里。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, the Emperor personally drove relay horses, traveling three hundred li per day.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, the emperor drove relay horses at three hundred li per day.

sentences.zh: 四皇后及文武侍衛數百人，並乘馹以從。

translations.literal: The four empresses and several hundred civil and military attendants all rode relays to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Four empresses and hundreds of attendants rode relays in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 房為天駟，熒惑主亂，此宣帝亂道德，馳騁車騎，將亡之誡。

translations.literal: Room is the Heavenly Team; Mars governs disorder—this was Emperor Xuan's moral disorder, galloping chariots and cavalry, the warning of impending fall.
translations.idiomatic: Room is the Heavenly Team; Mars governs disorder—Emperor Xuan's reckless racing was the warning of a falling throne.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，熒惑犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinsi day—Mars violated the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinsi: Mars crossed the Southern Dipper's fifth star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「且有反臣，道路不通，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Moreover there are rebellious ministers; roads are blocked; armies are broken and generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Rebel ministers appear; roads are cut; armies shattered and generals slain."

sentences.zh: 」尉迥、王謙等起兵敗亡之徵也。

translations.literal: Signs of Wei Cong, Wang Qian, and others raising armies, being defeated and perishing.
translations.idiomatic: Omens of Wei Cong and Wang Qian raising armies and dying in defeat.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，太白入南斗魁中。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiyou day—Venus entered the Dipper's handle.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiyou: Venus entered the Dipper's handle.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下有大亂，將相謀反，國易政。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great disorder throughout the realm; generals and ministers plot rebellion; the state changes government."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Realm-wide chaos, ministerial plots, regime change."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「君死，不死則疾。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The ruler dies; if not death, then illness."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The ruler dies—or if not, falls ill."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「天下爵祿。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Ranks and salaries throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Ranks and salaries spread across the realm."

sentences.zh: 」皆高祖受命、群臣分爵之徵也。

translations.literal: All signs of Gaozu receiving the Mandate and ministers receiving enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: All omens of Gaozu taking the Mandate and ministers receiving fiefs.

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌，歲星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, renxu day—Jupiter violated the great star of the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renxu: Jupiter crossed the Chariot's great star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主憂，若失勢。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The chief consort grieves; perhaps loss of power."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The chief consort grieves; she may lose power."

sentences.zh: 」周自宣政元年，熒惑、太白從歲星聚東井。

translations.literal: From Zhou's Xuanzheng first year, Mars and Venus followed Jupiter gathering at the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhou Xuanzheng first year, Mars and Venus followed Jupiter gathering at the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 大象元年四月，太白、歲星、辰星又聚井。

translations.literal: Daxiang first year, fourth month, Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury again gathered at the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Daxiang first year, fourth month, Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury again gathered at the Well.

sentences.zh: 十月，歲星守軒轅。

translations.literal: Tenth month—Jupiter guarded the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Jupiter guarded the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 其年，又守翼。

translations.literal: That year—it again guarded Wings.
translations.idiomatic: That year: it again guarded Wings.

sentences.zh: 東井，秦分，翼，楚分，漢東為楚地，軒轅後族，隋以後族興于秦地之象，而周之後妃失勢之徵也。

translations.literal: The Eastern Well is Qin's division; Wings is Chu's division; east of Han is Chu territory; the Chariot is the consort clan—an image of Sui rising through the consort clan in Qin territory, and Zhou's later consorts losing power.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Well is Qin, Wings is Chu, the Chariot the consort clan—Sui rising through in-laws in Qin while Zhou's empresses lost power.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，熒惑在虛，與填星合。

translations.literal: Yiyou day—Mars was in Void, conjoined with Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyou: Mars stood in Void, conjoined with Saturn.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵大起，將軍為亂，大人惡之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Armies rise on a great scale; generals rebel; the great man detests it."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Vast armies rise; generals rebel; the great man dreads it."

sentences.zh: 」是月，相州段德舉謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: That month, Duan Degao of Xiangzhou plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Duan Degao of Xiangzhou plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 其明年三月，杞公宇文亮舉兵反，擒殺之。

translations.literal: The next year, third month, Duke of Qi Yuwen Liang raised troops in rebellion and was captured and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, third month, Yuwen Liang, Duke of Qi, rebelled and was captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 二年四月乙丑，有星大如斗，出天廚，流入紫宮，抵鉤陳乃滅。

translations.literal: Second year, fourth month, yichou day—there was a star as large as a dou, issuing from the Celestial Kitchen, flowing into the Purple Palace, reaching Hooked Array and vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, fourth month, yichou: a dou-sized star from the Celestial Kitchen flowed into the Purple Palace, reached Hooked Array, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有大喪，兵大起，將軍戮。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is great mourning; armies rise on a great scale; generals are executed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great mourning, vast armies, executed generals."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「臣犯上，主有憂。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Ministers violate their superiors; the ruler has sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Ministers rebel against superiors; the ruler grieves."

sentences.zh: 」其五月，帝崩，隋公執國政，大喪、臣犯主之應。

translations.literal: Fifth month, the Emperor died; Duke of Sui held state power—responses to great mourning and ministers violating superiors.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month the emperor died; Duke of Sui seized power—fulfilling mourning and ministerial rebellion.

sentences.zh: 趙王、越王以謀執政被誅。

translations.literal: Princes Zhao and Yue were executed for plotting against the regent.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Zhao and Yue were executed for plotting against the regent.

sentences.zh: 又荊、豫、襄三州諸蠻反，尉迥、王謙、司馬消難各舉兵畔，不從執政，終以敗亡。

translations.literal: Also the barbarians of Jing, Yu, and Xiang rebelled; Wei Cong, Wang Qian, and Sima Xiaonan each raised armies in revolt, refusing the regent, and in the end were defeated and perished.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians of Jing, Yu, and Xiang rebelled; Wei Cong, Wang Qian, and Sima Xiaonan revolted against the regent and were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 皆大兵起、將軍戮之應也。

translations.literal: All responses to great armies rising and generals being executed.
translations.idiomatic: All fulfilling vast armies and executed generals.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，有流星一，大如三斗器，出太微端門，流入翼，色青白，光明照地，聲若風吹幡旗。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiachen day—there was one meteor as large as a three-dou vessel, issuing from the Supreme Palace End Gate, flowing into Wings, green-white, its light shining on the ground, with sound like wind blowing banners.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiachen: a three-dou meteor from the Supreme Palace End Gate flowed into Wings, green-white, lighting the ground, sounding like wind in banners.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有立王，若徙王。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is enthronement of a king, or transfer of a king."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "A king is enthroned or transferred."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「國失君。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The state loses its ruler."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The state loses its ruler."

sentences.zh: 」其月己酉，帝崩，劉昉矯制，以隋公受遺詔輔政，終受天命，立王、徙王、失君之應也。

translations.literal: That month, jiyou day, the Emperor died; Liu Fang forged an edict for Duke of Sui to receive the death testament and assist in government—in the end he received the Mandate—responses to enthronement, transfer, and loss of ruler.
translations.idiomatic: That month, jiyou, the emperor died; Liu Fang forged an edict making Duke of Sui regent—he took the Mandate—fulfilling enthronement and loss of ruler.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，歲星、太白合于張，有流星，大如斗，出五車東北流，光明燭地。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renzi day—Jupiter and Venus conjoined at Extended Net; there was a meteor as large as a dou, issuing northeast from the Five Chariots, flowing with bright light shining on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renzi: Jupiter and Venus conjoined at Extended Net; a dou-sized meteor northeast from the Five Chariots lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，熒惑、歲星合於翼。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiashen day—Mars and Jupiter conjoined at Wings.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiashen: Mars and Jupiter conjoined at Wings.

sentences.zh: 靜帝大定元年正月乙酉，歲星逆行，守右執法，熒惑掩房北第一星。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing, Dading first year, first month, yiyou day—Jupiter moved retrograde, guarding the Right Law-enforcer; Mars masked Room's north first star.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing, Dading first year, first month, yiyou: Jupiter retrograded guarding the Right Law-enforcer; Mars occulted Room's north first star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「房為明堂，布政之宮，無德者失之。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Room is the Bright Hall, the palace of spreading government—the unvirtuous lose it."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Room is the Bright Hall of governance—the unvirtuous lose it."

sentences.zh: 」二月甲子，隋王稱尊號。

translations.literal: Second month, jiazi day—Sui Wang assumed the title of honor.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiazi: Sui Wang assumed the imperial title.

sentences.zh: 高祖文皇帝開皇元年三月甲申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen, Kaihuang first year, third month, jiashen day—Venus visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen, Kaihuang first year, third month, jiashen: Venus visible by day.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太白經天晝見，為臣強，為革政。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Venus crossing the meridian visible by day—ministers are strong; government changes."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Daylight Venus on the meridian: ministers grow strong; government changes."

sentences.zh: 」四月壬午，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: Fourth month, renwu day—Jupiter visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renwu: Jupiter visible by day.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣強，有逆謀，王者不安。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great ministers are strong; there is treacherous plotting; kings are unsettled."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great ministers grow strong; treachery plots; kings are unsettled."

sentences.zh: 」其後，劉昉等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Afterward, Liu Fang and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Liu Fang and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，有流星，聲如隤牆，光燭地。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jisi day—there was a meteor with sound like a collapsing wall, its light shining on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jisi: a meteor roared like a collapsing wall, lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「流星有光有聲，名曰天保，所墜國安有喜。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "A meteor with light and sound is called Heavenly Protection; where it falls the state has rejoicing."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "A bright, sounding meteor is Heavenly Protection; where it falls the state rejoices."

sentences.zh: 」其九年，平陳，天下一統。

translations.literal: Ninth year, Chen was pacified and the realm was unified.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, Chen was pacified and the realm unified.

sentences.zh: 五年八月戊申，有流星數百，四散而下。

translations.literal: Fifth year, eighth month, wushen day—there were several hundred falling stars scattering in four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, eighth month, wushen: several hundred falling stars scattered in four directions.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「小星四面流行者，庶人流移之象也。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Small stars flowing in four directions—image of the common people wandering in migration."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Small stars scattering in four directions—common people displaced."

sentences.zh: 」其九年，平陳，江南士人，悉播遷入京師。

translations.literal: Ninth year, Chen was pacified and Jiangnan scholars were all relocated to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, Chen fell and Jiangnan scholars were relocated to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八年二月庚子，填星入東井。

translations.literal: Eighth year, second month, gengzi day—Saturn entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, second month, gengzi: Saturn entered the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「填星所居有德，利以稱兵。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Where Saturn dwells there is virtue; it is favorable to raise armies."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Where Saturn dwells virtue gathers; raising armies is favorable."

sentences.zh: 」其年大舉伐陳，克之。

translations.literal: That year a great campaign was launched against Chen and it was taken.
translations.idiomatic: That year a great campaign conquered Chen.

sentences.zh: 十月甲子，有星孛於牽牛。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiazi day—a broom star appeared at the Lead Ox.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiazi: a broom star appeared at the Lead Ox.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「臣殺君，天下合謀。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Ministers kill rulers; the realm plots together."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Ministers kill rulers; the realm plots together."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「內不有大亂，則外有大兵。

translations.literal: It is also said: "If there is not great disorder within, there is great warfare without."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "If not great internal disorder, then great external war."

sentences.zh: 牛，吳、越之星，陳之分野。

translations.literal: The Ox is the star of Wu and Yue; Chen's territorial division.
translations.idiomatic: The Ox marks Wu and Yue—Chen's division.

sentences.zh: 」後年，陳氏滅。

translations.literal: The year after, the Chen house perished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Chen dynasty fell.

sentences.zh: 九年正月己巳，白虹夾日。

translations.literal: Ninth year, first month, jisi day—a white rainbow flanked the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, first month, jisi: a white rainbow flanked the sun.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「白虹銜日，臣有背主。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "White rainbow holding the sun—ministers turn against their lord."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "White rainbow gripping the sun—ministers betray their lord."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「人主無德者亡。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Rulers without virtue perish."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Rulers without virtue perish."

sentences.zh: 」是月，滅陳。

translations.literal: That month, Chen was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chen was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 十四年十一月癸未，有彗星孛於虛危及奎婁，齊、魯之分野。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, eleventh month, guiwei day—there was a comet broom at Void, Rooftop, and Kui-Bond—Qi and Lu's territorial divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, eleventh month, guiwei: a comet broomed at Void, Rooftop, and Kui-Bond—Qi and Lu's divisions.

sentences.zh: 其後魯公虞慶則伏法，齊公高熲除名。

translations.literal: Afterward Duke of Lu Yu Qingze was executed by law and Duke of Qi Gao Jiong was stripped of his name.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Yu Qingze, Duke of Lu, was executed and Gao Jiong, Duke of Qi, was disgraced.

sentences.zh: 十九年十二月乙未，星隕於渤海。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, twelfth month, yiwei day—stars fell in Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteenth year, twelfth month, yiwei: stars fell in Bohai.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「陽失其位，災害之萌也。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Yang loses its place—the sprouting of disaster."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Yang loses its place—the first sprouting of disaster."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「大人憂。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The great man grieves."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "The great man grieves."

sentences.zh: 」二十年十月，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, tenth month—Venus visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: Twentieth year, tenth month: Venus visible by day.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣強，為革政，為易王。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Great ministers are strong; government changes; kings are replaced."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great ministers grow strong; government changes; kings replaced."

sentences.zh: 」右僕射楊素，熒惑高祖及獻後，勸廢嫡立庶。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Yang Su, with Mars alarming Gaozu and Empress Xian, urged deposing the heir and enthroning a lesser son.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director Yang Su, with Mars alarming Gaozu and Empress Xian, urged deposing the heir for a lesser son.

sentences.zh: 其月乙丑，廢皇太子勇為庶人。

translations.literal: That month, yichou day, Crown Prince Yong was deposed as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: That month, yichou, Crown Prince Yong was deposed.

sentences.zh: 明年改元。

translations.literal: The next year the era name was changed—all verifications of yang losing place and change of government and replacement of kings.
translations.idiomatic: Next year the era name changed—all fulfilling yang displaced and regime change.

sentences.zh: 皆陽失位及革政易王之驗也。

translations.literal: Renshou fourth year, sixth month, gengwu day—there was a star entering the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Renshou fourth year, sixth month, gengwu: a star entered the moon.

sentences.zh: 仁壽四年六月庚午，有星入於月中。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is great mourning; great armies; loss of a state; armies broken and generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great mourning, great armies, fallen state, shattered armies, slain generals."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有大喪，有大兵，有亡國，有破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yiwei day—the sun was green without light; after eight days it recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yiwei: the sun turned green and dim; after eight days it recovered.

sentences.zh: 」七月乙未，日青無光，八日乃複。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The ruler's power is seized."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The ruler's power is seized."

sentences.zh: 占曰：「主勢奪。

translations.literal: It is also said: "The sun without light—there is a dead king."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "A sun without light means a dead king."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「日無光，有死王。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) It is also said: "The sun without light—there is a dead king."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "A sun without light means a dead king."

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，上疾甚，丁未，宮車晏駕。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Jiachen day—the Emperor grew gravely ill; dingwei day, the imperial carriage halted forever.
translations.idiomatic: Jiachen: the emperor fell gravely ill; dingwei, the imperial carriage halted forever.

sentences.zh: 漢王諒反，楊素討平之。

translations.literal: Prince of Han Liang rebelled; Yang Su suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Han Liang rebelled; Yang Su suppressed him.

sentences.zh: 皆兵喪亡國死王之應。

translations.literal: All responses to armies, mourning, fallen state, and dead king.
translations.idiomatic: All fulfilling war, mourning, fallen state, and dead king.

sentences.zh: 煬帝大業元年六月甲子，熒惑入太微。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang, Daye first year, sixth month, jiazi day—Mars entered the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang, Daye first year, sixth month, jiazi: Mars entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「熒惑為賊，為亂入宮，宮中不安。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Mars is banditry and disorder entering the palace; unrest within the palace."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Mars is rebellion entering the palace—unrest within."

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.)
translations.idiomatic: (This closes the omen text cited above.)

sentences.zh: 三年三月辛亥，長星見西方，竟天，幹曆奎婁、角亢而沒；

translations.literal: Third year, third month, xinhai day—a long-tailed star appeared in the west, spanning heaven, crossing Kui-Bond, Horn, and Neck and vanishing;
translations.idiomatic: Third year, third month, xinhai: a long-tailed star in the west spanned heaven, crossing Kui-Bond, Horn, and Neck and vanishing;

sentences.zh: 至九月辛未，轉見南方，亦竟天，又幹角亢，頻掃太微帝座，干犯列宿，唯不及參、井。

translations.literal: By ninth month, xinwei, it appeared again in the south, also spanning heaven, again crossing Horn and Neck, repeatedly sweeping the Supreme Palace's imperial seat, violating the listed lodges, only not reaching Three Stars and the Well.
translations.idiomatic: By ninth month, xinwei, it reappeared in the south, again spanning heaven, sweeping the imperial seat and most lodges, stopping short of Three Stars and the Well.

sentences.zh: 經歲乃滅。

translations.literal: A full year passed before it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: A full year passed before it vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「去穢布新，天所以去無道，建有德，見久者災深，星大者事大，行遲者期遠。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Removing the foul and spreading the new—heaven removes the unvirtuous and establishes the virtuous; the longer it is seen the deeper the disaster; the larger the star the greater the affair; the slower its movement the more distant the term."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Heaven removes the wicked and raises the worthy; long visibility means deep disaster; large size, great events; slow motion, distant timing."

sentences.zh: 兵大起，國大亂而亡。

translations.literal: Armies rise on a great scale; the state falls into great disorder and perishes.
translations.idiomatic: Vast armies rise; the state collapses in great disorder.

sentences.zh: 余殃為水旱饑饉，土功疾疫。

translations.literal: Remaining calamities are flood, drought, famine, public works, and plague.
translations.idiomatic: Aftermath brings floods, drought, famine, public works, and plague.

sentences.zh: 」其後，築長城，討吐谷渾及高麗，兵戎歲駕，略無寧息。

translations.literal: Afterward the Great Wall was built, Tuyuhun and Goguryeo were attacked, armies marched every year with scarcely a moment's rest.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward came the Great Wall, campaigns against Tuyuhun and Goguryeo, and armies abroad every year without rest.

sentences.zh: 水旱饑饉疾疫，土功相仍，而有群盜並起，邑落空虛。

translations.literal: Floods, droughts, famines, plagues, and public works followed in succession, while bandits rose together and towns were emptied.
translations.idiomatic: Floods, drought, famine, plague, and public works followed; bandits rose and towns emptied.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，禮部尚書楊玄感于黎陽舉兵反。

translations.literal: Ninth year, fifth month, Minister of Rites Yang Xuangan raised troops in rebellion at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, fifth month, Yang Xuangan, Minister of Rites, rebelled at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，熒惑逆行入南斗，色赤如血，如三斗器，光芒震耀，長七八尺，於斗中句巳而行。

translations.literal: Dingwei day—Mars moved retrograde into the Southern Dipper, red as blood, like a three-dou vessel, its light blazing and shaking, seven or eight chi long, moving hooked within the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Dingwei: Mars retrograded into the Southern Dipper, blood-red and blazing like a three-dou vessel, seven or eight chi long, hooked within the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有反臣，道路不通，國大亂，兵大起。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There are rebellious ministers; roads blocked; great disorder in the state; armies rise on a great scale."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Rebel ministers, blocked roads, state chaos, vast armies."

sentences.zh: 」斗，吳、越分野，玄感父封于越，後徙封楚地，又次之，天意若曰，使熒惑句巳之，除其分野。

translations.literal: The Dipper is Wu and Yue's division; Xuangan's father was enfeoffed in Yue, later transferred to Chu—in second place—heaven seemed to say: let Mars hook and sweep his territorial division.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper is Wu-Yue; Xuangan's father held Yue then Chu—heaven seemed to sweep his division with Mars.

sentences.zh: 至七月，宇文述討平之。

translations.literal: By seventh month, Yuwen Shu suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: By seventh month Yuwen Shu suppressed him.

sentences.zh: 其兄弟悉梟首車裂，斬其党與數萬人。

translations.literal: His brothers were all displayed on poles and torn by chariots; tens of thousands of his followers were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: His brothers were torn by chariots; tens of thousands of followers were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 其年，硃燮、管崇亦于吳郡擁眾反。

translations.literal: That year, Zhu Can and Guan Chong also gathered hosts in rebellion in Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhu Can and Guan Chong rebelled in Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 此後群盜屯聚，剽略郡縣，屍橫草野，道路不通，齎詔敕使人，皆步涉夜行，不敢遵路。

translations.literal: Afterward bandits gathered, plundering commanderies and counties; corpses lay across the wilds; roads were blocked; envoys bearing edicts all traveled on foot by night, not daring to follow the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward bandits plundered counties; corpses filled the wilds; roads were cut; edict-bearers walked by night, avoiding the highways.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月，有星孛于文昌東南，長五六寸，色黑而銳，夜動搖，西北行，數日至文昌，去宮四五寸，不入，卻行而滅。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, sixth month—a broom star southeast of Literary Refinement, five or six cun long, black and sharp, moving and shaking at night, traveling northwest; after several days it reached Literary Refinement, four or five cun from the palace without entering, then retreated and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, sixth month: a black sharp broom star southeast of Literary Refinement moved northwest to the palace edge, retreated, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為急兵。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Urgent armies."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Urgent armies follow."

sentences.zh: 」其八月，突厥圍帝於雁門，從兵悉馮城禦寇，矢及帝前。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Turks besieged the Emperor at Yanmen; all soldiers manned the walls against the raiders; arrows reached before the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, Turks besieged the emperor at Yanmen; soldiers defended the walls as arrows fell before the throne.

sentences.zh: 七月，熒惑守羽林。

translations.literal: Seventh month—Mars guarded the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Mars guarded the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「衛兵反。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Guard troops rebel."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Imperial guards rebel."

sentences.zh: 」十二月戊寅，大流星如斛，墜賊盧明月營，破其衝輣，壓殺十餘人。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Twelfth month, wuyin day—a great meteor like a hu fell in bandit Lu Mingyue's camp, breaking his chariot frame and crushing over ten men to death.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuyin: a hu-sized meteor fell on bandit Lu Mingyue's camp, smashing his chariot frame and crushing ten men.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「奔星所墜，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Where a falling star strikes—armies are broken and generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Where a falling star strikes, armies break and generals die."

sentences.zh: 」其年，王充擊盧明月城，破之。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) That year, Wang Chong attacked and stormed Lu Mingyue's city and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wang Chong stormed Lu Mingyue's city and destroyed him.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月丙戌朔，日有食之，既。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, fifth month, bingxu new moon—solar eclipse, total.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year, fifth month, bingxu new moon: total solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「日食既，人主亡，陰侵陽，下伐上。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Total solar eclipse—the ruler perishes; yin invades yang; the lower overthrows the upper."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Total eclipse: the ruler dies; yin overwhelms yang; inferiors overthrow superiors."

sentences.zh: 」其後宇文化及等行殺逆。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Afterward Yuwen Huaji and others carried out regicide.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Yuwen Huaji and others murdered the emperor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大流星隕于吳郡，為石。

translations.literal: Guisi day—a great meteor fell in Wu commandery as stone.
translations.idiomatic: Guisi: a great meteor fell in Wu commandery as stone.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有亡國，有死王，有大戰，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is loss of a state; there is a dead king; there is great warfare; armies are broken and generals killed."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "A state falls; a king dies; great war; shattered armies and slain generals."

sentences.zh: 」其後大軍破逆賊劉元進于吳郡，斬之。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Afterward the great army broke the rebel Liu Yuanjin in Wu commandery and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the imperial army broke rebel Liu Yuanjin in Wu commandery and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，有大流星如斗，出王良閣道，聲如隕牆；

translations.literal: Eighth month, renzi day—there was a great meteor like a dou, issuing from Wang Liang's Skyway, with sound like a falling wall;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renzi: a dou-sized meteor from Wang Liang's Skyway roared like a falling wall;

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大流星如甕，出羽林。

translations.literal: Guichou day—a great meteor like a vat, issuing from the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: Guichou: a vat-sized meteor issued from the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，有枉矢二，出北斗魁，委曲蛇形，注於南斗。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuwu day—there were two Crooked Arrows, issuing from the Dipper's handle, winding serpent-shaped, pointing toward the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu: two Crooked Arrows issued from the Dipper's handle, serpent-winding toward the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「主以兵去，天之所伐。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "The ruler departs by armies—what heaven punishes."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "The ruler is driven out by armies—heaven's punishment."

sentences.zh: 」亦曰：「以亂伐亂，執矢者不正。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) It is also said: "Using disorder to punish disorder; the one who holds the arrow is not upright."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Disorder punishes disorder; the archer himself is unjust."

sentences.zh: 」後二年，化及殺帝僭號，王充亦於東都殺恭帝，篡號鄭。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Two years later, Huaji killed the Emperor and usurped the title; Wang Chong also killed Emperor Gong in the eastern capital and usurped the title of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Huaji murdered the emperor and usurped power; Wang Chong killed Emperor Gong in the eastern capital and seized the title of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 皆殺逆無道，以亂代亂之應也。

translations.literal: All responses to murderous rebellion and replacing disorder with disorder.
translations.idiomatic: All fulfilling murderous usurpation and replacing disorder with disorder.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月辛亥，大流星如甕，墜于江都。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, fifth month, xinhai day—a great meteor like a vat fell at Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth year, fifth month, xinhai: a vat-sized meteor fell at Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其下有大兵戰，流血破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Below there is great military battle, flowing blood, broken armies, and slain generals."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Great battle, bloodshed, shattered armies, and slain generals follow below."

sentences.zh: 」六月，有星孛於太微五帝座，色黃赤，長三四尺所，數日而滅。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Sixth month, a broom star appeared at the Five Emperors' Seat of the Supreme Palace, yellow-red, three or four chi long, vanishing after several days.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: a yellow-red broom star three or four chi long appeared at the Supreme Palace's Five Emperors' Seat and faded after several days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有亡國，有殺君。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "There is loss of a state; there is regicide."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "A state falls; the ruler is murdered."

sentences.zh: 」明年三月，宇文化及等殺帝也。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Third month of the next year, Yuwen Huaji and others killed the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Third month next year, Yuwen Huaji and others murdered the emperor.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，熒惑犯太微，日光四散如流血。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinyou day—Mars violated the Supreme Palace; sunlight scattered in four directions like flowing blood.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinyou: Mars crossed the Supreme Palace; sunlight scattered like flowing blood.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「賊入宮，主以急兵見伐。

translations.literal: Interpretation says: "Bandits enter the palace; the ruler is attacked by urgent armies."
translations.idiomatic: The reading says: "Bandits enter the palace; the ruler is attacked by urgent armies."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「臣逆君。

translations.literal: It is also said: "Ministers rebel against the ruler."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Ministers rebel against the ruler."

sentences.zh: 」明年三月，化及等殺帝，諸王及幸臣並被戮。

translations.literal: (Closing quotation.) Third month of the next year, Huaji and others killed the Emperor; all princes and favored ministers were slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: Third month next year, Huaji and others murdered the emperor; princes and favored ministers were all slaughtered.
